subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Graded reader 2: The Blue Butterfly
outcomes: I can find the hobbies people are doing in the park.
I can understand what each "butterfly" really is.
I can complete a summary of the story.

tf.s: Jood and Hassan are doing photography in the park.
Hassan wants to take a photo of a red butterfly.
tf.why: Hassan wants a photo of a blue butterfly.

tf.s: The first "butterfly" is really an eraser on a puzzle book.
The second "butterfly" is a badge on a costume.
The real butterfly is on top of a table tennis bat.
tf.why: Yes! It lands on the bat.

tf.s: Some girls are playing board games in the park.
The boys are wearing costumes and crowns in the show.
tf.why: Correct! They are putting on a show.

tf.s: Hassan is sad because he loses his camera.
tf.why: He is sad because he can't find a blue butterfly.

tf.s: A group of boys are putting on a show.
tf.why: Yes! The boys put on a show.

tf.s: The story happens at the sports centre.
tf.why: The story happens in the park.

What does Hassan want a photo of?

boxes.why: It's an eraser on a puzzle book.
It's on top of the bat.

boxes.q: Who are putting on a show?
boxes.why: The boys put on a show.

mcq.q: Which hobbies do people do in the park?
o: doing puzzles, putting on a show, doing photography, playing table tennis
making models, cooking, writing a diary, gardening
playing video games, watching cartoons, hockey, rugby
mcq.why: These four hobbies are in the story.

o: an eraser on a puzzle book
mcq.why: It's a badge on a costume.

mcq.q: Who is with Hassan doing photography?
mcq.why: Jood and Hassan take photos together.

o: something a king or queen wears on the head
mcq.why: A crown goes on the head.

mcq.q: Complete: Hassan finds a blue butterfly on top of his ___.
mcq.why: It's on his table tennis bat.

mcq.q: Choose: Some children ___ in the park.
mcq.why: Some children are playing table tennis.

o: The boys are putting on a show.

o: He can't find a blue butterfly.
